name: Square Yards
description: Square Yards brings Indian real estate search and analysis into Claude. Look up resale and rental listings, browse new-construction projects, and get locality recommendations ranked for either living or investment. Compare properties, projects, or localities side by side, drill into full details on any one of them, and calculate home-loan EMIs or affordability. It also handles India-specific area-unit conversions and answers general buying, renting, and selling questions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Square Yards to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Square Yards to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://sy-mcp.squareyards.com/mcp/external.

_published_faq.name: Is Square Yards MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Square Yards scores 97/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Square Yards MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Square Yards provides these MCP tools: area_conversion, compare_entities, estimate_home_loan, get_entity_details, recommend_localities, search_entities, search_faq, search_projects, and search_properties.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Square Yards?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Square Yards in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does Square Yards MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Square Yards does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Square Yards is developed by Square Yards Technology Private Limited. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
